description: Adversarial doubles through PoseSE3 (t: Vec3=double[3], q: QuaternionXYZW=double[4]). Pins the ECMA-262 number-to-string rule: shortest round-trip, integer-valued doubles without a decimal point, and exponential form for 1e21.
exercises: integer-valued doubles 0.0 and 1.0 -> 0 and 1 (no decimal point)
